session_summary: Completed a run on Whispering Fen, earned 25 coins, and successfully purchased and equipped the Trail Cap cosmetic from the marketplace for 45 coins, ending with 88 coins.

observations.evidence: Completed Whispering Fen route and earned currency, but lacked any visible milestone trackers for unique collectibles like Mooncaps or Fen Pearls.
observations.recommendation: Introduce a route discovery ledger or collection milestone UI so collectors can track their finds across different themes.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased the trail_cap cosmetic item with coins earned from the route.
observations.recommendation: Continue offering diverse cosmetic options and thematic hats to keep collectors motivated.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
feature_requests.player_value: Gives collectors a clear view of missing items, unique collectibles per route, and completion milestone rewards.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, exploring various routes lacks a dedicated ledger to track specific regional collectibles like Ember Shards or Mooncaps.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game ledger or collection tracker showing item counts and completion percentages per route.

feature_requests.title: Thematic Cosmetic Pack Expansion
feature_requests.player_value: Provides more long-term cosmetic goals for dedicated explorers who want to showcase route mastery.
feature_requests.rationale: With 7 cosmetics currently available, collectors quickly acquire them and look for additional customization pieces themed after specific routes like Ember Forge or Moon Shrine.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a fresh batch of region-themed cosmetic items and hats to the marketplace.

keep: Smooth route completion flow granting immediate coin rewards
Clear marketplace purchase feedback confirming equipped cosmetics
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
